title: IIT GATE 2027 Online Form
postName: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering – GATE 2027
vacancyDetails: National level exam for M.Tech/Ph.D admissions and PSU recruitment; new paper Robotics & Automation (RA) introduced
qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Technology/Architecture/Science or final year as per GATE eligibility
applicationFee: As per GATE 2027 brochure (category-wise regular / late fee)
selectionProcess: Computer Based Test → Scorecard valid for admissions & PSUs
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in
2. Open GOAPS registration from 14 August 2026
3. Register, fill form, upload photo/sign/documents
4. Pay fee (regular till 21 Sep 2026; with late fee till 30 Sep 2026)
5. Download confirmation page
shortDescription: IIT GATE 2027 Online Form – registration from 14 Aug 2026 at gate2027.iitm.ac.in. Exam in Feb 2027 (IIT Madras).
content:
GATE 2027 is organised by IIT Madras. Online registration opens on 14 August 2026 via GOAPS.

Key dates

  • Regular registration closes: 21 September 2026
  • With late fee: till 30 September 2026
  • Exam: 6, 7, 13, 14, 20 & 21 February 2027

Official site: gate2027.iitm.ac.in.
